text: No supplements? Bro, you'll never grow! I take twelve every morning!
A supplement fills gaps in your diet. It doesn't replace food, sleep, or training.
Only a few have strong research behind them. Creatine. Protein powder, for convenience. Caffeine. And vitamin D, if you're low.
Get the basics right first. Then add supplements to fill real gaps.
This series breaks down each one. Follow, so you don't miss it.
